definitions: A user interface component or system that dynamically generates forms or renders UI elements based on a predefined data schema.
A software tool or library that interprets a schema (e.g., JSON Schema) to create interactive forms or display data structures without explicit UI coding.
examples: The application uses a schema-driven form/renderer to handle various data inputs.
Developers appreciate the flexibility of a schema-driven form/renderer for rapid prototyping.
A robust schema-driven form/renderer ensures data validation at the UI level.
